decisive_items: induced sputum was trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert
subsequently grew MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid
Biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus
response.rationale: R1 is directly confirmed by culture and biopsy findings of MTB, explaining the systemic symptoms, spine, and renal abnormalities. R4 only reflects a secondary renal manifestation without a primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Urinary findings are nonspecific and secondary to the underlying infection; no primary renal disease is supported.
